subject: design/feature-draft-lock-record
statement: Record each approved draft lock as an annotated lock/<feature>/vN tag on its mainline merge commit, after rechecking the exact-head operator approval.
intent: Keep a versioned, fresh-clone-readable approval and contract anchor after draft working files are removed.
rationale: The push job inspects each first-parent mainline commit, identifies its merged draft pull request, reads the preparation digest and proposal count, and publishes a closed typed tag. Reruns compare the full record and reuse an unpublished matching local tag.
fit_criterion: A lock merge writes one tag with version, both roles, capture line or lineless, head, digest, pull request, and proposal count; ordinary merges write none; reruns converge; a fresh clone reads the tag and renders the locked PRD.
